disputes.description: Both functions are modeled with object name 'this' in the packet but are different owner objects (raw C for 0x004A4900 is (_DWORD *this, int a2); raw C for 0x004CF070 is (int this)). Offsets 0x0C/0x10/0x14 coincide numerically (pit animation pointers vs feedback array pointer / reaction count) but refer to distinct objects. Widths agree; ownership must be split during reconciliation, not merged.

The packet-level record carries one signature, but the two functions diverge: 0x004A4900 is (this, int a2) -> unsigned __int8; 0x004CF070 is (this) -> _DWORD*. A single return_type 'opaque' and the a2 parameter are a representative union, not either function's exact ABI.
